snippet.title: Incredible Ink (Escape, Level 1 - 10) [Full HD]
snippet.description:
Video ini merupakan bagian dari seri "OMG: Oh My Games!": https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQ5yWEreP4-3W7IRE1xjeWhdQS4BESrkg

Menampilkan gameplay walkthrough dari game Incredible Ink yang saya mainkan di mode Escape dari level 1 sampai dengan level 10. Mode Escape ini mengharuskan kita untuk melarikan sebuah bola putih dengan cara menorehkan tinta hitam untuk memantulkan dan mengarahkan bola, agar dapat menuju ke pintu keluar.

--------------------

Daftar isi:
00:00 - Menu tour
01:22 - Level 1: Learn to Draw Lines of Ink
03:14 - Level 2: Leaves May Hide Things
03:59 - Level 3: Multiball Makes Short Work of It
04:54 - Level 4: Gremlins Destroy Balls, but not Bombs
05:38 - Level 5: Beware: the Gremlin is Tricky
06:46 - Level 6: Bombs Blow Up Rocks and Gremlins!
08:27 - Level 7: Wax Seals Cover the Exit
09:17 - Level 8: Some Ice Blocks Disappear When Hit
10:51 - Level 9: Pinwheel
12:09 - Level 10: Fireballs Destroy Things Fast

--------------------

Game title: Incredible Ink
Release date: December 1, 2004
Developer: GameHouse
Publisher: GameHouse
Genre: Puzzle
Mode: Single-player

The pen is truly mightier than the sword in this exciting action-puzzler from the creators of Mah Jong Medley and Super Collapse! II. Use your feather quill to guide the ball around the screen in two action-packed game modes! Whether you like a thoughtful puzzle or a brick-busting free-for-all, Incredible Ink has it all! Gems and power-ups thicken the plot, but keep an eye out for Gremlins and other nasty hazards. Fantastic fun for the entire family!

- Unlimited Play
- Two Game Modes: Escape and Break All!
- Tons of Exciting Levels
- Beautiful Graphics and Sounds
- Easy to Learn and Play
